concerns.text: SC-002 specifies a runtime target of < 4 hours on “standard hardware” but does not define what hardware configuration (CPU, cores, RAM, OS) or measurement method (wall‑clock, CPU time, profiling tool) should be used, making the criterion ambiguous and potentially unmeasurable.

SC-003 sets a memory‑footprint target of < 4 GB RAM under “full load” without describing what constitutes full load (e.g., number of subjects, parallelism) or how memory usage should be measured (peak RSS, virtual memory, profiling tool), which hampers reproducible verification.
